deadline.value: Apply by December 15 (2026 for Fall 2027); the application opens August 1. Fall entry only.
deadline.quote: The application period opens on August 1 each year. The deadline for applying for Fall admission is December 15.

gre_general.value: The General GRE is not required and carries much less weight than the Mathematics Subject GRE.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores are not required by UT Austin but the Mathematics GRE is highly recommended (optional).

gre_subject.value: The Mathematics Subject GRE is optional but highly recommended; there is no cut-off and it is one factor in a holistic review.
gre_subject.quote: GRE scores are not required by UT Austin but the Mathematics GRE is highly recommended (optional). There is no minimum score required.

toefl_min.value: The department quotes a TOEFL score of 21.5 (apparently a section-level score on the 30-point scale, with 23 a plus) rather than a total; the Graduate School minimum of 79 total still applies. Duolingo 135 (145 preferred) is accepted.
toefl_min.quote: A TOEFL score of at least 21.5, an overall IELTS band score of 7.5, or a DuoLingo overall score of 135 minimum (though a 145 is preferred) is considered sufficient.

ielts_min.value: The department considers an overall IELTS band of 7.5 sufficient (8.0 is a plus); slightly lower scores are sometimes admitted if speaking is strong.
ielts_min.quote: an overall IELTS band score of 7.5

supervisor.value: Applications are reviewed by the department's faculty admissions committee; your chosen area of interest only routes your file and does not commit you.
supervisor.quote: The Department’s Graduate Admissions Committee considers the following factors in arriving at its decision concerning the admission of an applicant | The selection does not commit you to specializing in that area.

funding.value: All PhD students making satisfactory progress get five years of support (TA, GRA or fellowship); offers of admission include funding with no separate application.
funding.quote: The Mathematics Department provides five years—ten Fall or Spring semesters—of financial support to all Ph.D. students who are making satisfactory progress towards their degrees.

also.quote: Our offers of admission come with a package of financial support; no separate application is required.

entry_route.value: Apply with a strong undergraduate mathematics record (analysis, algebra, topology); graduate courses help but are not required.
entry_route.quote: Not every successful applicant has had the opportunity to take graduate classes.

notes: About 15 admitted from over 400 applicants per year. Applied mathematics applicants can also apply to the Oden Institute CSEM PhD.
